release: Theme 1.32.0 (Labs Code Studio, shipped as a draft)
note: Theme only, on production 1.31.1 (release commit 68d81af, main f02c2fb). Baseline: the 1.31.1 release manifest (287 files, sha256 29d3d926...). Core stays 1.10.0. 8 files: the 4 new Code Studio files (lesson data, the sanitiser and checks, the page script, the template part), then inc/labs.php (it reads the new lesson data and template part), assets/data/labs/catalog.json (code-studio listed with status draft), assets/css/labs.css, and style.css last (version 1.32.0, switch file). Code Studio stays a draft: /labs/code-studio/ answers 404 and it is not in the Labs list, search, sitemap or related links until a separately approved publish. No new rewrite rule and no database change. Nothing else changes: Design Library (gate closed), Industry Hub, SVG Motion Studio, Learn and the three published Labs tools stay byte-identical to 1.31.1.

B.check: Existing 101 URLs unchanged from the 1.31.1 state; /labs/ and the three published tools answer 200 with no script error; /labs/code-studio/ (also without the trailing slash, upper case, ?lesson= and /index.php/) answers 404 and Code Studio is not in /labs/, the Labs search, /labs-sitemap.xml, robots.txt or the related links; /design/... and /design-sitemap.xml still answer the closed-gate 404; style.css?ver=1.32.0; all 8 files match the manifest.

after_apply: Do not reset OPcache or purge caches unless separately approved: 1.31.0 and 1.31.1 showed new files are picked up without a reset.
after_rollback: Without --remove-added the 4 added Code Studio files stay on the server: once inc/labs.php and catalog.json are restored nothing loads them and /labs/code-studio/ stays 404 (the two scripts and the lesson JSON stay reachable by their URLs; harmless, no secret). Use --remove-added to remove them.
No rewrite rule or database change to undo.
Check the 101 URLs match the 1.31.1 state (style.css?ver=1.31.1, /labs/ and the three tools 200, /labs/code-studio/ 404). Cache purge and OPcache reset only with separate approval.
